title: settings.me — contact/notification prefs (AFB-only; not part of afb.execution.v1 wire)
description: Every property optional — the on-disk file only stores what the user overrode, and settings/set accepts partial updates. `sound` is canon (notification sound id, e.g. 'game/coin').

notify_system.description: System stability notifications (afb.notification.system.v1: source health, data freshness, resource watchdog, unclean startup) — manager role only, server ignores writes from other roles (see api/ws_handlers.py::handle_settings).
